I answered Marcus in the #north-team thread: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

I got that from #north-team itself, where Marcus is a member. On Aug 20, 2025, Dana posted there that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift, and that Dana was looking into it herself. Thea also shows up as the Quarrendon contact in #inc-qfl-sev1, which Marcus is in too.

A contact name is an operational fact, so Marcus can see it as a North team member. I didn't need any direct messages or other private sources.
